description: Where open positions on a Hyperliquid perp would be liquidated if the price moved: notional (size x liquidation price) by price range, longs below the current price and shorts above, with running totals from the price outward. Built from every open position in our node's latest state snapshot, about every 12 minutes (snapshot.age_s says how old). Cross-margin prices assume the account's other positions stay at mark, so a real move that drags correlated markets liquidates earlier; portfolio-margin accounts use Hyperliquid's own liquidation price. For liquidations that already happened use get_liquidation_levels. Without a key you get the 10 largest ranges within 10% of the price; any key, including a free one (https://ironflow.sh/key), returns every range.

bucket_size.description: Price range width: auto (default, about 0.25% of price) or a number in the market's price units, as text or a number

market.description: Market: BTC-PERP, xyz:NVDA-PERP, HYPE/USDC, or a Hyperliquid name (BTC, @107, xyz:NVDA)

range_pct.description: How far from the current price to cover, in percent. Default 20, max 50

name: get_liquidation_map

outputSchema.description: Projected liquidations by price for one market

portfolio_margin_pct.description: Percent priced with Hyperliquid's own liquidationPx

with_liq_px_pct.description: Percent of it with a liquidation price

cum_long_usd.description: Long notional liquidated from the price down to here

cum_short_usd.description: Short notional liquidated from the price up to here

long_usd.description: Long notional liquidated in this range

short_usd.description: Short notional liquidated in this range

notice.description: Present without a key: the result is a 10-range sample

snapshot.description: The node state snapshot the positions come from

stale.description: True when the last snapshot could not be read and an older map is served

title: Liquidation map
